title: Combined-game integration dependency graph
evidence_level: source-proven only; nothing here is Studio or runtime evidence
purpose: Order the path from preserved RBXL content through HubTown, route, dungeon, loot and return, making every runtime-gate dependency explicit so preparation and activation cannot be confused for each other.

gate_vocabulary.none: No gate. The work is inert data, docs or tooling and may merge on review alone.
gate_vocabulary.studio-extraction: Blocked on re-extracting the source place. Cannot be unblocked from the repository.
gate_vocabulary.prep-only: May be fully prepared and CI-green, but must stay dormant and unwired.
gate_vocabulary.v2.7-R1: Requires the canonical R1 Studio evidence packet.
gate_vocabulary.v2.7-R2: Requires PR #221 merged with its runtime evidence, then the R2 delayed-ready and late-join evidence.
gate_vocabulary.v2.7-R3: Requires R2 evidence before semantic/change-token suppression may be implemented.
gate_vocabulary.v2.7-R5: Requires soak, closure and compatibility-removal evidence.
gate_vocabulary.integration: Requires the R gates plus an accepted integration gate before anything is wired into a production bootstrap.

nodes.summary: Preserved 2026-08-07 Studio RBXL import: the only surviving record of the legacy game.
nodes.status: DAMAGED — 17 of 28 sources and 122 of 1,775 Workspace rows survive
nodes.notes: Everything downstream inherits this limit. docs/production/RBXL-IMPORT-INTEGRITY-2026-08-07.md is the finding; scripts/verify_studio_import_package.py pins the recovery level in CI.

nodes.summary: Re-extract the 11 lost sources and the full 1,775-row Workspace hierarchy from the source place.
nodes.status: REQUIRED, NOT STARTED — user action outside the repository
nodes.notes: The only node in this graph that no agent can advance. It gates authored-structure work but deliberately does not gate the contract and audit work, which is why the graph routes around it wherever possible.

nodes.summary: Migration truth: what the legacy place contained, who owns each part canonically, and what was lost.
nodes.status: DONE for BA-001 and BA-003; BA-002 PARTIAL pending stage.reextraction
nodes.notes: The two instance manifests partition the recovered Workspace index with no overlap and no gap; the script matrix classifies all 28 preserved scripts.

nodes.summary: Guards that keep the legacy stack dead and the prepared content honest.
nodes.notes: Deliberately early. Every later stage adds content that could reintroduce a second authority, so the guards must exist before the content does.

nodes.summary: Stable world-content IDs and shared contracts used by every later content domain.
nodes.notes: The migration truth established that legacy instance names are not unique, so canonical content must mint its own ids. BA-004 is where that rule becomes a type.

nodes.summary: Quest, NPC, crafting, gathering and vendor contracts as pure, dormant modules.
nodes.notes: Inputs are recorded: QuestService for BA-020, GATHERING-CRAFTING-CONCEPTS.md plus the recovered Resources folders for BA-023, HubTownService concepts for BA-024. HubTownConfig never existed, so the vendor catalog is new design.

nodes.summary: Dungeon/expedition content contract and portal destination/eligibility contract.
nodes.notes: Launch authority already belongs to ExpeditionLobbyService. The portal contract contributes destination and eligibility data only; a second launch path is forbidden.

nodes.summary: Enemy archetype, loot/build-decision and progression coverage audits.
nodes.notes: Docs and data only, so these can run entirely in parallel with the contract stages. The BA-003 matrix already names each audit's legacy input.

nodes.summary: Fixture proving quest, crafting, vendor, gathering and NPC references resolve without cycles or orphans.
nodes.notes: Test-only, so it may merge independently once the contracts exist. Extends the same completeness discipline the manifest validator already applies.

nodes.summary: HubTown composition specification, model/placement strategy and interaction registry.
nodes.status: BLOCKED — no depth-3 HubTown row survives and no transform survived at all
nodes.notes: BA-010 additionally owes an explicit art-direction decision: HubTown is a medieval hub while the canonical world is a forest extraction setting. That decision is not blocked by re-extraction and should be made first.

nodes.summary: First authored outdoor route, its encounter beats and its landmark/discovery definitions.
nodes.status: READY — unblocked by BA-002 against canonical landmarks
nodes.notes: The queue lists BA-050 and BA-052 as blocked on BA-002. BA-002 resolves that dependency in the only honest way available: the legacy world contributes almost nothing recoverable, so the canonical WorldFoundationConfig landmarks and WorldFoundationService routes are the design base. This node deliberately does not depend on stage.reextraction.

nodes.summary: First repeatable dungeon content and its elite/boss reward decisions.
nodes.notes: Must reuse the canonical room/encounter/boss/reward stack. The legacy DungeonService supplies ideas and pacing reference, never a second generator.

nodes.summary: Missing enemy archetypes and deterministic item-generation/affix rules.
nodes.notes: The recovered RNG layer is the most directly reusable legacy material, but every entry point defaults to Random.new() when no seed is passed. A canonical seedable resolver must require the seed.

nodes.summary: First-session onboarding, action-map audit, input abstraction and UI information architecture.
nodes.notes: All four legacy client scripts are lost with no reference copy, so BA-063 designs from the canonical loop rather than waiting. This node is deliberately independent of stage.reextraction.

nodes.summary: VERTICAL-SLICE-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md: the exact PR/merge order once the gates open.
nodes.status: BLOCKED on the prepared subsets it sequences
nodes.notes: Docs-safe, but only meaningful once the branches it orders exist. It sequences promotion; it does not authorize it.

nodes.summary: Canonical R1 Studio evidence packet accepted; PR #221 single-listener consolidation promoted with its runtime evidence.
nodes.notes: Independent of every Lane B node above, which is the whole point of the two-lane rule. Preparation never waits on this and never bypasses it.

nodes.summary: Client-ready gating activated using the prepared PR #222 publisher primitive; delayed-ready and late-join evidence captured.
nodes.notes: #222 must not merge or activate before #221 and its evidence.

nodes.summary: Semantic key and mutation-derived change-token suppression across the state producers.
nodes.notes: Explicitly not authorized for activation before R2 evidence.

nodes.summary: Presentation ownership centralized; zero broad production Highlight targets; stream-out/rebind proven.
nodes.notes: Every REPLACE lighting/VFX entry in the HubTown and world manifests lands downstream of this gate. Migrating legacy emissive parts before presentation ownership is centralized would reintroduce exactly the incident R4 exists to close.

nodes.summary: Soak, reset/respawn/late-join/two-player matrices, closure packet, and gated compatibility removal.
nodes.notes: Compatibility may only be removed for ledger rows with accepted replacement evidence and a retained rollback checkpoint.

nodes.summary: Integration gate: prepared content may begin entering production bootstraps in BA-073 order.
nodes.notes: This is the only node where preparation becomes activation. Both halves are required: the runtime gates must be closed out and the integration plan must exist.

nodes.summary: Prepare and loadout: player chooses a build/weapon before leaving the hub.
nodes.notes: First player-facing beat of the north-star sequence.

nodes.summary: HubTown activation: safe space, vendors, quest board and portal entry.
nodes.notes: Carries the heaviest external dependency in the graph because it needs stage.reextraction transitively.

nodes.summary: Authored outdoor route with landmarks, discovery and mixed-combat beats.
nodes.notes: Enemy pressure comes from the existing EnemyDirectorService authority; BA-041 adds configs and pure resolvers, never a competing service.

nodes.summary: Repeatable dungeon sequence with elite reward decision and boss/terminal outcome.
nodes.notes: Uses the canonical expedition runtime, room placement, encounter coordinator and boss phase resolver.

nodes.summary: Reward, result and return: the loop closes and invites another run.
nodes.notes: Reward distribution, result and replay decision already exist canonically with fixture coverage. This step wires prepared content into them; it does not rebuild them.
